mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_user_session WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND idle_expires_at>#{now} AND absolute_expires_at>#{now} ORDER BY login_time DESC,session_id DESC
SELECT session_id FROM t_user_session WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND idle_expires_at>#{now} AND absolute_expires_at>#{now} ORDER BY login_time ASC,session_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_session SET last_activity_time=#{lastActivityTime},idle_expires_at=#{idleExpiresAt},version=version+1 WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND revoked_at IS NULL

UPDATE t_user_session SET revoked_at=#{revokedAt},revoked_by=#{revokedBy},revoke_reason=#{reason},revoke_type=#{revokeType},version=version+1 WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL

UPDATE t_user_session SET revoked_at=#{revokedAt},revoked_by=#{revokedBy},revoke_reason=#{reason},revoke_type=#{revokeType},version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND session_id<>#{excludedSessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE t_user_session SET revoked_at=#{revokedAt},revoked_by=#{revokedBy},revoke_reason=#{reason},revoke_type=#{revokeType},version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE t_user_session SET revoked_at=#{now},revoke_reason='会话过期',revoke_type='EXPIRED',version=version+1 WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND (idle_expires_at<=#{now} OR absolute_expires_at<=#{now})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_user_session WHERE revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at<#{retainedBefore}
